integrity: The geometric proof uses the published local quotient types and one-sided intersection computation, derives the symmetric resolution directly from the equation, and distinguishes proof from the ancillary symbolic bookkeeping check.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes 1<=n<m and square-free f. The n=0 boundary and multiple-root degenerations are excluded. A classical equivalent formulation in the theory of rational C*-surfaces or ruled compactifications may exist but was not located in the checked sources.
title: Dual Hirzebruch models for an unequal-weight del Pezzo family
